## What changes

<!-- Tell what changes for the user and why. Link the issue: "Closes #123". -->

## Kind of change

- [ ] A defect fix
- [ ] A new feature or a change to a feature
- [ ] A new language adapter (docs/EXTENDING.md)
- [ ] A new agent provider (docs/EXTENDING.md)
- [ ] Documents only

## Tests

- [ ] `npm run format` and `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run test:rust`
- [ ] `npm run test:browser`, and I looked at the phone and desktop screenshots (interface changes)
- [ ] A new test fails before this change and passes after it

## Rules (CONTRIBUTING.md)

- [ ] Inspection stays read-only, and every tracked file stays visible with a label.
- [ ] Relationships stay static, and unresolved or ambiguous targets stay explicit.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens or source from another repository are in the change.
- [ ] New interface parts have no cards, bands, tinted boxes, badges or shadows around status.
- [ ] Documents for people are in Simplified Technical English, with no em dashes.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has one line under `## [Unreleased]`.
